facts.description: Always true. What an element that must always show hangs its condition on: <fg-alert> renders hidden unless something drives it, and a Direct File alert is shown whenever its screen is.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/flowAlwaysTrue">
  <Description>Always true. What an element that must always show hangs its condition on: <fg-alert> renders hidden unless something drives it, and a Direct File alert is shown whenever its screen is.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <True/>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.description: Screen gate: isFalseOrIncomplete(/hasInterestReports).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/isNotHasInterestReportsOrIncomplete">
  <Description>Screen gate: isFalseOrIncomplete(/hasInterestReports).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Any>
      <Not>
        <IsComplete>
          <Dependency path="/hasInterestReports"/>
        </IsComplete>
      </Not>
      <Not>
        <Dependency path="/hasInterestReports"/>
      </Not>
    </Any>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Payer
facts.description: The entity that paid the interest income, used on Form 1040 Schedule B, Part 1, Line 1
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/interestReports/*/payer">
  <Name>Payer</Name>
  <Description>The entity that paid the interest income, used on Form 1040 Schedule B, Part 1, Line 1</Description>
  <Export mef="true" stateSystems="true"/>
  <Writable>
    <String/>
    <Limit type="Match">
      <String>(([A-Za-z0-9#\-\(\)]|&|')\s?)*([A-Za-z0-9#\-\(\)]|&|')</String>
    </Limit>
    <Limit type="MaxLength">
      <Int>75</Int>
    </Limit>
  </Writable>
</Fact>
